content.text:
This figure is from NACA Technical Memorandum 579, Structural Details of German Light Airplanes (1930, scanned).
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
This figure shows eight technical drawings of German light airplanes from NACA Technical Memorandum No. 579, including side, front, and top views of various aircraft models.

Labels, values, units, part numbers, and notes printed in the figure:

- N.A.C.A. Technical Memorandum No. 579
- Figs. 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8
- Figs. 1,2 Albatros L 79 airplane
- Figs. 3,4 Arado L 2 airplane
- Figs. 5,6 Bayerischen Flugzeugwerke M 23b airplane
- Figs. 7,8 Akademischen Fliegergruppe Darmstadt D 18 airplane
